business_summary: Sichuan Zhongguang Lightning Protection Technologies Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of lightning protection services in China and internationally. The company offers lighting rods, earthing products, power supply SPD, SSD, signaling SPD, antenna feeder SPD, combined and intelligent SPD, distributed fault location products, lightning monitoring and warning systems, lightning counters, PDU, power filters, magnetic components, and circulator isolators. It also provides communication, buildings, wind power, photovoltaic, and LED luminaries solutions. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
